---
title: "Shark Attacks"
---

The Global Shark Attack File (GSAF) is a collection of reported shark-human incidents, including when and where they happened and what activity was underway. This site uses a cleaned version of its records to explore patterns in reported attacks.

Shark encounters can be frightening, and individual attacks can be serious. But shark attacks are uncommon, and dramatic coverage can make the danger seem greater than the risk most people face. Looking at the data helps put that fear in context without dismissing the harm to those involved.

The Map page shades countries by the number of attacks recorded in this dataset. The Trends page counts attacks by activity and shows categories with at least 50 incidents. These summaries describe recorded incidents, not the likelihood of an attack during a particular visit.
